listings.title: November Bird Monitoring Walk
listings.description:
All birders welcome on our monthly(ish) monitoring walk. 

All birders — current, experienced, newbie and would-be — welcome!

Join our monthly monitoring walk to record birds at the Museum’s trails, forest, and meadow. Learn something new, share what you know, or both! Most fun for adults, older children.

Please bring your own binoculars and dress for the weather. We recommend bringing tick repellent and a water bottle.

listings.title: Holiday Jasper Hill Fondue Night
listings.description: Join us for a very special Holiday Fondue Feast, set in the winter wonderland of our decked out Clubhouse! The Makery will be on site so you can craft your own ornament. Our oh-so-gooey dinner starts off with Welcome Hour—time to mix and mingle, sip a seasonal holiday drink from our Clubhouse Bar, and explore our festive af Clubhouse space. For the main event, we’ll take our seats for a holiday feast—overflowing bowls of fresh salad, vintage fondue pots with award-winning local cheese from Jasper Hill Farm, and platters piled high with dippables. Vegan friends welcome—we rock a vegan fondue!

listings.title: Pints & Pups
listings.description: This month, the original dog friendly Tap Room at Switchback is open in support of Passion 4 Paws! Join us on the last Sunday of each month throughout the winter for good beer, McKenzie hot dogs, and an afternoon with your best furry friend by your side.

listings.title: Paul Winter’s Winter Solstice Celebration
listings.when: Fri., Dec. 4, 7:30 p.m. and Sat., Dec. 5, 3 p.m.
listings.description: The Paul Winter Consort, with beloved vocalist Theresa Thomason, brings the timeless music of their legendary New York solstice events, in a joyous and profound celebration of the season of renewal and the greater family of life on Earth. The Consort of Paul on soprano sax, Theresa, cello, bass, piano, organ, and percussion presents two identical shows. See website or below for a retrospective video, Solstice Saga, interweaving iconic performances from the first forty years of solstice celebrations at the Cathedral of St. John the Divine, New York City.

listings.title: Lane Series: Còig
listings.venue: The University of Vermont Recital Hall
listings.description: They’re back! Còig, the Celtic acoustic powerhouse from Cape Breton Island, returns for another beautiful holiday show, which Lane Series audiences have come to adore as a way to welcome in the season. With a fiery style at its core, Còig easily shifts from the repertoire of past generations to original and upbeat compositions, featuring the band’s use of over a dozen instruments. With driving tunes, haunting songs, and infectious energy, Còig is an unparalleled musical force. Fronted by Darren McMullen and Rachel Davis, the band also includes Québécois guitarist/bouzouki player Thierry Clouette and iconic fiddler Margie Beaton.

listings.title: Richmond Holiday Marrket
listings.description:
Richmond Holiday Market
Saturday, December 5, 2026 - 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Richmond Congregational Church and Richmond Town Center, Bridge Street, Richmond, Vermont
Free admission to more than 40 crafters in both buildings on all floor levels. Table proceeds benefit Richmond Food Shelf (non-perishable food donation bin available). Silent Auction benefits Toys for Kids (toy donation bin available). In conjunction with the Richmond Free Library’s Book Sale. 
Radiate Art will have children’s crafts available in the basement of the Town Center. Lunch will be available for a fee by Congregational Church. Richmond Community Band will play festive music. Free

listings.title: Bella Voce Concert "Cool Yule"
listings.when: Sat., Dec. 5, 3 p.m. and Sun., Dec. 6, 3 p.m.
listings.venue: McCarthy Arts Center, Saint Michael's College
listings.description: This joyful concert features fresh, jazzy arrangements of beloved holiday favorites by Vermont composer Dr. James Stewart. A highlight of the program is his delightfully wicked arrangement of Deck the Halls, bringing together the voices of Bella Voce with Dr. Stewart and Collaborative Pianist Sam Whitesell at the piano, joined by Sam's twin brother, Jake Whitesell, on saxophone for a performance full of holiday spirit and irresistible energy. The instrumental trio also shines in Stewart's lush and nostalgic Sentimental Christmas Medley, featuring the timeless classics Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas and I'll Be Home for Christmas. The program is…

listings.title: Shake It Till You Make It! Newcomer's Burlesque Showcase
listings.venue: Off Center for the Dramatic Arts
listings.description: Green Mountain Cabaret is opening our stage to rising Burlesque talent, bringing back our annual Newcomers Showcase on DECEMBER 5th. For some, it may be the first time; others may have a few acts under their shimmy belt but are just starting out. Either way, a cast of new performers with 2 years or less of Burlesque stage experience are ready to take the spotlight in an evening of fun and friendly competition. Many local favorites have participated in this event, going on to entertain as a staple in the Vermont Burlesque community and beyond! Be there as we crown…

listings.title: Vermont Symphony Orchestra's Holiday Pops
listings.description: We’re celebrating the season with music that is both reflective and radiant—sending audiences home with a melody in their hearts and a sense of holiday warmth. Our upcoming Holiday Pops concerts feature the full orchestra alongside VSO’s 80-voice chorus, leading spirited sing-alongs and performing festive favorites by Leroy Anderson, George Frideric Handel, Duke Ellington, and Georges Bizet. Beloved traditional carols round out this joyful, family-friendly holiday tradition.

listings.title: Cheryl A. Ossola in Conversation with Lisa DeNatale | How Long a Shadow
listings.description: Phoenix Books is excited to welcome author Cheryl A. Ossola to Phoenix Books Burlington on Sunday, December 6 at 3:00 PM in collaboration with our friends at The Vermont Italian Cultural Association! Cheryl will be in coversation with Lisa DeNatale for an afternoon of book talk focused on Cheryl's new book, How Long a Shadow.

listings.title: Architecture + Design Film Series, The First Siza
listings.description:
The First Siza takes Pritzker Prize winning Portuguese architect Alvaro Siza back more than 60 years to the very first house he designed, while still a student. Now an internationally celebrated architect, Siza returns to the house and tours it with his original clients and their family, who have lovingly lived there for three generations. This remarkable encounter connects the young architect he once was with the master he became, offering an intimate and moving reflection on architecture, memory, family, and the enduring life of a building.

listings.title: Lane Series: Lorelei Ensemble
listings.venue: The University of Vermont Recital Hall
listings.description: We love a choral holiday event, and we have been trying to book the Lorelei for a long time! Heralded for its “white-hot intensity” (The New York Times), the Grammy-nominated Lorelei Ensemble is recognized across the globe for its bold and inventive programs that champion the extraordinary flexibility and virtuosity of the human voice. Recognized for its rich and diverse vocal palette, the ensemble is celebrated for its compelling delivery of “exact, smooth, and stylish” programming (The Boston Globe). This will be a vocal holiday program of unparalleled creativity and originality.

listings.title: WTF! Welcome to Fatherhood Workshop
listings.description: This three-hour workshop for expecting dads takes place quarterly at Dad Guild. Dads-to-be get a crash course on all things baby-related, including hearing from a doula from Vermont Doula Company. Participants get a free copy of the book, "Baby 411".

listings.title: Brushes and Beats: Musical And Art Benefit For CKD
listings.description: The evening will bring toghter Vermont musians, artists, patients, caregivers, friends and families. Music will be provided by Brett Hughes, Bob Wagner, G Rockwell, Matt Flinner and Rod Driscoll, along with an art exhibit featuring works created by patients, caregivers, friends and family members. Most importantly, all proceeds from the event will go to support Vermonters battling Chronic Kidney disease.

listings.title: Dads & Kids Dining Hall Takeover
listings.venue: Alliot Student Center, Saint Michael's College
listings.description: Dads and kids are invited to join Dad Guild for a weeknight dinner at the St. Michael's College Dining Hall. Enjoy a wide range of foods that are guaranteed to please even the pickiest of eaters. And did we mention the creemee machine?

listings.title: Solaris Season of Light - Burlington, VT
listings.description: SEASON OF LIGHT Songs of Hope, Wonder and Joy - Our most luminous concert yet! Just days before Christmas, Solaris Vocal Ensemble invites you to pause from the holiday hustle and celebrate the season with music that shines. Featuring the beautiful and expressive sounds of harpist Rebecca Kauffman performing alongside Solaris, Season of Light brings together joyful seasonal favorites and music that invites us to reflect on the deeper meaning of the season.
